description: The router core: Query(text, types[]|all, limit) fans out to matching registered providers over HTTP+JSON (plus CLI fallback), with bounded concurrency, per-provider timeout, and partial results. Candidates are collected with provenance and (pre-rerank) grouped by provider — no false cross-provider score interleave.

requirements.title: Bounded concurrent fan-out with provenance
requirements.description: Query fans out to every registered provider whose type matches the requested --type tokens (or all active providers under --all), bounded by a concurrency cap and a per-provider timeout. Each returned hit carries provider_id, provider_group, type, and a path/id locator.

validation.notes: Query --type a,b only calls providers of types a and b.
A provider exceeding the per-provider timeout is dropped; the query still returns the rest.

requirements.title: Declarative result-mapping (no per-provider code)
requirements.description: The fan-out applies each provider's declarative ResultMapping (JSON-path field selectors + score scale + optional filter_field/filter_value for multi-leaf-on-one-endpoint) to map heterogeneous responses onto unified SearchHits. Scores normalize to a common [0,1] band before any ranking.

validation.notes: A REST and a Connect-via-JSON provider both map onto identical SearchHit shape via their mappings alone.
A filter_field/filter_value mapping selects only matching leaf rows from a shared endpoint (e.g. ui-health kind=surface).

requirements.title: Multi-provider fan-out proven
requirements.description: At least three providers (cli-health.commands, ui-health.surfaces, swarm-manager.records) are registered and federated end-to-end so a single query reaches multiple corpora and returns grouped results.

validation.notes: query "restart a scenario" --type command,doc returns grouped hits from the matching providers.
